verses.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֶקְרָ֗א אַֽל־ תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי צוּרִי֮ פֶּן־ תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’eq·rā ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš mim·men·nî ṣū·rî pen- te·ḥĕ·šeh mim·men·nî wə·nim·šal·tî ‘im- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Of David To You O LORD I call be not deaf to me O my Rock For if You remain silent . . . I will be like those descending to the Pit

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־ קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃ דְּבִ֥יר
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nay bə·šaw·wə·‘î ’ê·le·ḵā bə·nā·śə·’î yā·ḏay ’el- qāḏ·še·ḵā də·ḇîr
verses.literal: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You {for help} when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary

verses.original: אַל־ תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־ פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם־ רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tim·šə·ḵê·nî ‘im- rə·šā·‘îm wə·‘im- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen dō·ḇə·rê šā·lôm ‘im- rê·‘ê·hem wə·rā·‘āh bil·ḇā·ḇām
verses.literal: Do not drag me away with the wicked and with the workers of iniquity who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts

verses.original: תֶּן־ לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם וּכְרֹ֪עַ תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם יְ֭דֵיהֶם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָשֵׁ֖ב לָהֶֽם׃ גְּמוּלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ten- lā·hem kə·p̄ā·‘o·lām ma·‘al·lê·hem ū·ḵə·rō·a‘ tên lā·hem yə·ḏê·hem kə·ma·‘ă·śêh hā·šêḇ lā·hem gə·mū·lām
verses.literal: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil Repay them for what their hands have done bring back on them what they deserve

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־ פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל־ יָדָ֑יו מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·ḇî·nū ’el- pə·‘ul·lōṯ Yah·weh wə·’el- yā·ḏāw ma·‘ă·śêh ye·her·sêm wə·lō yiḇ·nêm
verses.literal: Since they show no regard . . . for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done He will tear them down and never rebuild them

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי־ שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh kî·šā- šā·maʿ qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nāy
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD for He has heard my cry for mercy

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ לִבִּ֗י בָטַ֥ח בּ֤וֹ וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי לִבִּ֑י וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃ וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘uz·zî ū·mā·ḡin·nî lib·bî ḇā·ṭaḥ bōw wə·ne·‘ĕ·zā·rə·tî lib·bî way·ya·‘ă·lōz ’ă·hō·w·ḏen·nū ū·miš·šî·rî
verses.literal: The LORD is my strength and my shield my heart trusts in Him and I am helped Therefore my heart rejoices and I give thanks to Him with my song

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז־ לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ōz- lā·mōw ū·mā·‘ō·wz yə·šū·‘ō·wṯ mə·šî·ḥōw hū
verses.literal: The LORD is the strength of His people a stronghold of salvation for His anointed

verses.original: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה׀ אֶת־ עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־ הָעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wō·šî·‘āh ’eṯ- ‘am·me·ḵā ū·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā ū·rə·‘êm wə·naś·śə·’êm ‘aḏ- hā·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Save - Your people and bless - Your inheritance shepherd them and carry them forever
